verdict.rationale: Linear ships its own AI agent, so asking whether that agent can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. The evidence shows only the opposite direction: Linear provides an official MCP server that Cursor, Claude and v0 connect to. Nothing documents users adding third-party MCP servers for Linear Agent to call, and server-side MCP support does not count toward this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
